definitions.explanation: The act of keeping, raising, and caring for animals, whether livestock, pets, or animals in captivity such as zoos.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パンダ→パンダ：11257_panda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飼育|しいく}する。
examples.english: To raise pandas at a zoo.

examples.japanese: {飼育|しいく}⟦{係|がかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The zookeeper takes care of the animals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飼育|しいく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Raising cattle requires a large amount of land.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{飼|し}→飼：noentry⟧ (to raise/keep) + ⟦{育|いく}→育：noentry⟧ (to nurture/raise). Combines the concepts of keeping and nurturing animals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飼育|しいく}する (to raise/keep animals)
・{飼育|しいく}⟦{係|がかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧/{飼育|しいく}⟦{員|いん}→員：01994_in⟧ (zookeeper, animal keeper)
・{飼育|しいく}⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (breeding environment)
・{飼育|しいく}⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (method of raising)
・{飼育|しいく}⟦{下|か}→下：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be kept in captivity)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep/raise - more casual, for pets)
・⟦{畜産|ちくさん}→畜産：16090_chikusan⟧ (animal husbandry - industry focus)
・⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧ (fish farming, aquaculture)
・⟦{繁殖|はんしょく}→繁殖：08671_hanshoku⟧ (breeding, reproduction)
・⟦{家畜|かちく}→家畜：06431_kachiku⟧ (livestock)

USAGE NOTE: {飼育|しいく} is more formal than ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧. Use {飼育|しいく} for professional or scientific contexts (zoos, farms), while ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ is used for keeping pets at home.
